claims.text: On an ASM and could become preg: folic acid ≥0.4 mg daily preconception and in preg (↓NTDs).
claims.quote: Clinicians should prescribe at least 0.4 mg of folic acid supplementation daily preconceptionally and during pregnancy to any PWECP treated with an ASM to decrease the risk of NTDs
claims.locator: Pack AM, et al. Teratogenesis, Perinatal, and Neurodevelopmental Outcomes After In Utero Exposure to Antiseizure Medication: Practice Guideline From the AAN, AES, and SMFM. Neurology 2024
